rv.q: His wonderful writing, direction, choreography and costumes make this production a winner.
My Brother Langston is deeply satisfying on many levels. As they say, 'It's Almost Like Coming to Church'!
My Brother Langston is exciting and engaging, making you want to learn more about the character.
While 'My Brother Langston' succeeds as a great introduction to the life and times of Langston Hughes, it will likely leave members of the audience wanting more.
This show truly blew me away. I'm already doing research into the life of Langston Hughes. Reuben Echoles and this cast have left me wanting more….a lot more.
My Brother Langston is a witty, informative, and well-put-together production. I highly recommend this production to those, especially the Harlem Renaissance era fans.

cn.t: Critics praise "My Brother Langston" as a heartfelt, powerful tribute to the legendary poet, with Rueben D. Echoles' writing and direction earning acclaim for capturing Hughes' revolutionary spirit and the healing power of his work.
